mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.5% consistently indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the next 20 trading days, the S&P 500 produces negative returns in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPIAUCSL inflation exceeding 3.0% triggers market expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in monthly payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decreases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate a rapidly tightening labor market that precedes monetary policy tightening and negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle economic expansion, declining housing starts (HOUST) relative to the prior month signals weakening consumer demand and impending economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, when HOUST declines, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing activity and strong economic growth, supporting positive equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO rises, the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals a weakening labor market and potential economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate broad-based weakening in consumer demand, preceding economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where both RSAFS and HOUST decline, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained federal funds rate below 1.5% for three months indicates prolonged monetary accommodation, supporting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Over the next 60 trading days, the S&P 500 produces negative returns in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS has been below 1.5% for the past 3 months.
